title: Thirteen Inter players are away with their countries
description: Inter Women open their Serie A season on Sunday at the Arena Civica in Milan, and admission is free.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 23, Thursday, September 24, 2026 — Thirteen Inter players are away with their countries

blocks.html: Inter have thirteen players away with their countries in the season's first break, and three play today. Inter Women are at home first: they open their Serie A season against Fiorentina on Sunday at the Arena Civica, and it is free to get in. The men return on October 10, against Parma.

blocks.h3: Thirteen Inter players are away with their countries
paras: Inter named thirteen players in national-team squads on Wednesday. Italy took four: Nicolò Barella, the midfielder; Alessandro Bastoni, the center back; Federico Dimarco, the left back; and Francesco Pio Esposito, the young forward. Lautaro Martínez, the captain and striker, is with Argentina.

Three play today: Ange-Yoan Bonny, the forward, with Ivory Coast against Ghana; Yann-Aurel Bisseck, the defender, with Germany against the Netherlands; and Aleksandar Stankovic, the midfielder, with Serbia against Greece. Italy meet Belgium on Friday.

Also away: the midfielders Petar Sucic (Croatia), Andy Diouf (France) and Piotr Zielinski (Poland), the goalkeeper Josep Martínez (Spain) and the defender Manuel Akanji (Switzerland). One name is disputed. Corriere dello Sport reported on Tuesday that Dimarco had left Italy's camp with a knee problem, and the club's list, published a day later, still names him.

blocks.h3: Inter Women open their Serie A season on Sunday, free of charge
paras: Inter Women play Fiorentina on Sunday at 7:00 AM ET, 13:00 CEST, at the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan. It is their first match of the Serie A season, and admission is free.
They arrive on the back of Tuesday's 1–0 win over BK Häcken on their Champions League debut, which left them third in the league phase.

blocks.h3: Corriere dello Sport: Dimarco has the whole break to recover
paras: Corriere dello Sport says Federico Dimarco's problem is a sprained knee, picked up in the match against Napoli. He now has the length of the break in Milan to get over it before Parma on October 10. Monday's report called his withdrawal a precaution; this one names the injury.

The same piece has Djed Spence, the defender, available as soon as the squad reconvenes. It gives good prospects for Hakan Calhanoglu, the midfielder, and no date for John Stones, the center back. Cristian Chivu gave the players a week off; they are back at Appiano Gentile, Inter's training ground, on Monday.

blocks.h3: L'Équipe: Zidane may start Andy Diouf at left back
paras: Zinédine Zidane takes charge of France for the first time on Friday, away to Turkey. L'Équipe reports that Andy Diouf, the Inter midfielder, is in line to start the match at left back.
Chivu has used Diouf on the right of midfield this season. The paper calls it a bold choice.
